strings.off_no_crucible: Inscribe is off: this server does not run Meadworks.
strings.off_no_inscribe: Inscribe is off: this server does not run Inscribe. Your items keep their runes and levels.
strings.import_sync_incomplete: The import was saved locally, but configuration synchronization did not complete. Keep the backups and do not retry this preview.
strings.import_recovery_incomplete: The import failed and recovery did not complete. Inspect the retained backups before continuing.
strings.stackable_gear: {0} stacks up to {1} (another mod changed it), so it cannot get a rarity.
strings.step_aside_rarity: Inscribe runes step aside because {0} is installed. Remove {0} to use Inscribe runes; Meadworks can import its settings.
strings.step_aside_enhancement: Inscribe leaves enhanced items and enhancement scrolls to {0} while it is installed. Remove {0} to convert them to Inscribe inscriptions and runes.
strings.step_aside_all: Inscribe is off because EliteCrafting and ItemEnhancements are installed; Meadworks can import their settings.
strings.confirm_body: Use the {1} on {0}? This cannot be undone.
strings.rune_awakening_desc: An old rune from an earlier Inscribe: it becomes an Ascension Rune as soon as it loads.
strings.rune_recasting_desc: Recasts an Uncommon item: both inscriptions are replaced by two new ones. It stays Uncommon.
strings.rune_ascension_desc: Raises an item one rarity step and keeps its inscriptions: Common becomes Uncommon with two inscriptions; Uncommon becomes Rare and Rare becomes Epic, with one more each. At the Rune Table an essence chooses what it adds. Legendary gear comes only from bosses and raids.
strings.rune_cleansing_desc: Wipes an Uncommon or better item back to Common. Every inscription is lost. Cannot be undone.
strings.rune_serpent_desc: Corrupts an Uncommon or better item, then seals it for good: it stays as it is, gains one more inscription past its limit, or has every inscription rerolled. No rune works on it again.
strings.rune_msg_not_own_inventory: Runes work only on items in your own inventory.
strings.rune_msg_stone_out_of_reach: Take the rune from your inventory or the chest you have open.
strings.rune_msg_newer_format: This item was changed by a newer version of Inscribe or EliteCrafting.
strings.rune_msg_stone_disabled: The {0} is disabled on this server.
strings.rune_msg_sealed: This item is sealed. No rune can change it.
strings.rune_msg_unknown_rarity: This item's rarity is not known on this server.
strings.rune_msg_wrong_rarity: The {0} does not work on {1} items.
strings.rune_msg_ascension_top: The Ascension Rune cannot raise {0} items: it stops at Epic, and Legendary gear comes only from bosses and raids.
strings.rune_msg_no_eligible_affix: No inscription can roll on this item.
strings.rune_msg_affixes_full: This item cannot hold another inscription.
strings.rune_msg_corrupt_seal: The Serpent seals {0}. Nothing else changes.
strings.rune_msg_corrupt_chaos: The Serpent seals {0} and twists every inscription.
strings.scroll_tier1_desc: No longer used. Turns into Honing Runes or Essence when carried, or when its chest is opened.
strings.scroll_tier2_desc: No longer used. Turns into Honing Runes or Essence when carried, or when its chest is opened.
strings.scroll_tier3_desc: No longer used. Turns into Honing Runes or Essence when carried, or when its chest is opened.
strings.scroll_tier4_desc: No longer used. Turns into Honing Runes or Essence when carried, or when its chest is opened.
strings.affix_warding_line: After 10 s without damage, a ward absorbs the next {0} damage
strings.affix_purifying_line: Burning, poison and frost wear off {0}% faster
strings.affix_gleaner_line: {0}% chance for picked plants to yield double
strings.affix_seafarer_line: A ship you steer sails {0}% faster
strings.rune_msg_gem_swap_kept: {0} replaces the gem in socket {1}: {2}. The old gem ({3}) comes back.
strings.rune_msg_gem_swap_lost: {0} replaces the gem in socket {1}: {2}. The old gem ({3}) shatters.
strings.gem_replace_chance: The old gem comes back {0}% of the time.
strings.rune_honing_desc: Hones one inscription you pick: it rises one tier, up to the best tier the item's level allows, and its value is rolled again in that tier.
strings.rune_tempering_desc: An old rune from an earlier Inscribe: it becomes a Honing Rune as soon as it loads.
strings.rune_msg_affix_at_top: That inscription is already at the best tier this item allows.
strings.rune_msg_affix_is_flag: That inscription has no value to change.
strings.cfg_1_general__accessory_rarity_help: Rings and belts (Mantle) and trinkets can drop with a rarity and take runes. Off: new ones stay Common and runes refuse them; inscriptions they already have are kept and still apply. Host or server; default on. For one kind only, set rolls: false on the ring, belt or trinket class in Inscribe.economy.yml.
strings.cfg_2_runes__runes_from_salvage_help: Salvaging an Uncommon, Rare or Epic item (Kindle's Salvage) may give back the Ascension Rune that raised it, one time in four. Legendary items give none.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gem_recovery_common_help: Percent chance a gem comes back when it is replaced in a Common item or the item is salvaged; otherwise the gem is lost. Host or server; default 100.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gem_recovery_uncommon_help: Percent chance a gem comes back when it is replaced in a Uncommon item or the item is salvaged; otherwise the gem is lost. Host or server; default 90.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gem_recovery_rare_help: Percent chance a gem comes back when it is replaced in a Rare item or the item is salvaged; otherwise the gem is lost. Host or server; default 75.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gem_recovery_epic_help: Percent chance a gem comes back when it is replaced in a Epic item or the item is salvaged; otherwise the gem is lost. Host or server; default 50.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gem_recovery_legendary_help: Percent chance a gem comes back when it is replaced in a Legendary item or the item is salvaged; otherwise the gem is lost. Host or server; default 25.
strings.cfg_4_drops__magic_item_drops_help: Creatures and bosses drop gear of Uncommon rarity or better.
strings.cfg_4_drops__uncommon_drop_weight_help: Multiplies how often dropped gear is Uncommon (green), against the drop tables. 1: as the tables say; 0: never. Host or server; the next drop uses it.
strings.cfg_4_drops__rare_drop_weight_help: Multiplies how often dropped gear is Rare (blue), against the drop tables. 1: as the tables say; 0: never. Host or server; the next drop uses it.
strings.cfg_4_drops__epic_drop_weight_help: Multiplies how often dropped gear is Epic (purple), against the drop tables. 1: as the tables say; 0: never. Host or server; the next drop uses it.
strings.cfg_4_drops__legendary_from_wildblood_bo: A boss kill may drop one Legendary (gold) item, when Wildblood is installed. Legendary never drops from other creatures, chests, crafting or runes. Host or server.
strings.cfg_4_drops__legendary_from_wildblood_ra: A won Wildblood raid may drop one Legendary (gold) item at the raid site. Host or server.
strings.cfg_4_drops__legendary_boss_chance_help: Percent chance a boss kill drops a Legendary item, while Legendary From Wildblood Bosses is on. Host or server.
strings.cfg_4_drops__legendary_raid_chance_help: Percent chance a won raid drops a Legendary item, while Legendary From Wildblood Raids is on. Host or server.
strings.cfg_7_ground_glow__ground_glow_help: Dropped Uncommon or better gear glows in its rarity color.
strings.cfg_7_ground_glow__loot_beam_help: Glowing dropped gear also shows a beam of light in its rarity color.
strings.cfg_2_runes__biome_essences_help: The Rune Table also offers the Mist (Mistlands), Ash (Ashlands) and Frost (Deep North) essences, which steer the Ascension Rune toward movement and stealth; fury, ammunition and thrown weapons; or warmth, food, meads and endurance. Off: only the first five essences are offered; essence in the pool and inscriptions already rolled are kept. Host or server; default on.
strings.cfg_1_general__enabled_help: Whole product. Off: items keep and show their state; nothing rolls, drops or applies.
strings.cfg_1_general__rarity_enabled_help: Item rarity, inscriptions and runes. Off: nothing new rolls or drops and inscriptions stop applying; existing item data is kept and shown.
strings.cfg_1_general__inscription_effects_help: Off: inscriptions are kept and shown, but none applies.
strings.cfg_2_runes__modify_equipped_items_help: Runes may be applied to equipped items.
strings.cfg_2_runes__confirm_destructive_runes_h: How confirm-gated runes (Cleansing, Sealed) ask first: HoldShift, a yes/no Dialog, or Off.
strings.cfg_2_runes__rune_table_help: The Rune Table (hammer, Crafting tab): holds runes, turns trophies into essence and applies runes; an essence chooses what the Ascension Rune adds. Off: it cannot be built or used; what it holds is kept.
strings.cfg_2_runes__gems_and_sockets_help: Weapons, staves, armor, shields and backpacks hold up to three sockets: the Dvergr Chisel cuts them and the eleven gems fill them. Off: the chisel and gems neither drop nor work; socketed gems keep their stats.
strings.cfg_4_drops__chest_drops_help: World chests roll runes and gear once.
strings.cfg_4_drops__wildblood_star_synergy_help: Wildblood's stars raise Inscribe's drop chances.
strings.cfg_5_commands__read_only_commands_for_e: Everyone may use inscribe inspect, stats, list and help.
strings.cfg_6_display__colored_item_names_help: Item names show in their rarity color.
strings.cfg_6_display__tooltip_detail_help: Tooltip block: Compact, Standard or Full.
strings.cfg_6_display__show_dormant_inscriptions: Inscriptions whose definition is gone show grayed.
strings.cfg_7_ground_glow__glow_max_lights_help: Only the nearest this many items hold a live light.
strings.cfg_7_ground_glow__glow_refresh_seconds_: How often the nearest items are chosen again.
strings.cfg_9_cheats__item_commands_help: Cheat. Enables inscribe give, roll, reroll and cleanse console commands.
strings.enhancement_converted: {0}: enhancement +{1} became {2} inscription tiers and {3} Honing Runes.
strings.scrolls_converted: Old enhancement scrolls became {0} Honing Runes and {1} Essence.
strings.enhancement_convert_no_room: Make room in this inventory: old enhanced items and scrolls convert once their replacement fits.
strings.enhancement_convert_dropped: Converted runes that did not fit in this inventory were dropped at your feet.
strings.cfg_7_ground_glow__legendary_glint_help: Dropped Legendary gear also shows a small bronze and ivory glint on the ground. Other rarities never glint. This client only.
